set.statement: The root daemon fills the machine-wide maxRuns round-robin across projects, each turn taking that project's next ready change set in its own roadmap order, except that every project's queued continuations take freed slots first (see root-continuations-first), and never runs more of a project's change sets at once than its optional per-project max.

ops.note: Refines the owner-picked round-robin: rotation and roadmap order stay, but queued continuations, then queued starts and plan requests, go ahead of ready change sets machine-wide.
